dedupe_keys.name: plantoact task 2 1 energy system data collection and validation for pilot areas of plantoact project

description: PLANtoACT researchers publish energy-production and consumption templates for five pilot regions and fifteen municipalities, with regional comparisons between partner-provided and independently collected public-source data. The regions are Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Lombardia, Alba County, Oberland and metropolitan Porto. Template themes cover final consumption, electricity production, thermal production and mobility, with units, reference years, sources and assumptions recorded by the project. Municipal data additionally include district-heating share. The collection also contains reusable blank templates and a source catalogue. These components form one regional energy-data assembly for regional energy-system simulations. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The related hourly profiles and spatial potential estimates are separate resources. A limitation is that individual reference years, deviations and reported validation accuracy were not inspected. No workbook, catalogue-file body or energy observation was downloaded.
